props_model.method: poisson over expected BF x blended K/BF x opponent K% factor; free MLB StatsAPI

props_model_tb.method: exact convolution of per-PA base outcomes over the plate-appearance distribution; free MLB StatsAPI
props_model_tb.bias_note: aggregate calibration is good (-1.2pts) but that is cancellation. Bucketed by predicted probability both this and kpoisson-v1 are wrong by 7-17pts. Cause is mean scaling, not variance: held-out regression slope 0.63 for K and 0.21 for TB, so projections over-spread. Slope correction fixes the centre but is unvalidated at tail lines. Neither market is cleared to post.
